name: TJSETIA
recent: TJSETIA 近期只有董事及大股东权益变动与场内交易公告，包括董事 Loo Ming Chee 和董事经理 Wee Eng Kong 在公开市场增持股份。公司于 2026 年 8 月 28 日发布截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度的业绩报告。近期没有新闻。
notable: 董事 Loo Ming Chee 于 2026 年 10 月 26 日以约 RM10,558 在公开市场增持 56,200 股普通股。
董事经理 Wee Eng Kong 于 2026 年 10 月 9 日以约 RM18,738 在公开市场增持 99,000 股普通股。

recent_en: TJSETIA recently only had announcements on changes in directors' and substantial shareholders' interests and dealings in listed securities, including on-market acquisitions by Director Loo Ming Chee and Managing Director Wee Eng Kong. The company released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026 on 28 August 2026. There was no recent news.
notable_en: Director Loo Ming Chee acquired 56,200 ordinary shares on the open market on 26 October 2026 for approximately RM10,558.
Managing Director Wee Eng Kong acquired 99,000 ordinary shares on the open market on 9 October 2026 for approximately RM18,738.
